sharon-woods: During harbor construction, Great Parks directs visitors to the U.S. 42/Lebanon Road entrance, which remains open and connects to Buckeye Falls Drive.
The Sharon Woods entrance from U.S. 42/Lebanon Road will remain open, and guests can use this entrance to connect to Buckeye Falls Drive, which leads all the way to Sharon Woods Golf Course.

The project page gives conflicting dates for the East Kemper Road entrance: its closure list says October 2026–May 2027, but its FAQ says until the harbor reopens. Confirm the entrance before travel; the harbor reopening is tentatively spring 2028.
Entry drive from Kemper Road (Highbanks): October 2026-May 2027
Construction work will require Great Parks to close the Sharon Woods entrance from East Kemper Road until the harbor reopens.
Spring 2028 Harbor area reopens Timeline is an estimate based on the current project status and is subject to change.
The harbor project closes about 0.3 miles of Sharon Lake Trail from October 2026 through project completion, and about 0.1 miles of Buckeye Falls Trail near the harbor until the project finishes.

Because the Sharon Lake Trail passes through the harbor, reconstruction of the harbor requires Great Parks to close a small section of the trail (approximately 0.3 miles) from October 2026 through the project's completion.
A short section of Buckeye Falls Trail (approximately 0.1 miles) near the harbor will also be closed until the project is finished.

The harbor-project FAQ says boating is not permitted until summer 2027, when the temporary boathouse at Lakeside Lodge on the east side of Sharon Lake is due to reopen. This is a planned reopening, not confirmation that boats are available now.
Boating will not be permitted until summer 2027. Great Parks will reopen the temporary boathouse at Sharon Woods' Lakeside Lodge on the east side of Sharon Lake in summer 2027.
Great Parks requires a valid Motor Vehicle Permit for vehicle entry to its parks and conservation areas; its stated exceptions are Otto Armleder Memorial Park and Fernbank Park.
A valid Motor Vehicle Permit (MVP) is required for vehicle entry at Great Parks’ parks and conservation areas across Hamilton County.
Otto Armleder Memorial Park and Fernbank Park are co-managed by Great Parks, the Cincinnati Park Board, and the Cincinnati Recreation Commission and do not require a Motor Vehicle Permit.

Sharon Center lists restrooms and parking. Its posted September 8–December 31, 2026 hours are daily 10 a.m.–5 p.m., with closures for Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas, New Year’s Eve and New Year’s Day. Restroom layout and changing equipment are not described.
Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas, New Year's Eve & New Year's Day

great-wolf-lodge-mason: The Mason FAQ says waterslides and elevated attractions are not wheelchair accessible.
Waterslides and our elevated attractions are not wheelchair accessible.
Accessible suites are marked with an accessibility icon during booking. The FAQ lists 800-605-9653 for guests who prefer to reserve by phone.
Accessible suites are labeled as such and marked by an accessible icon within the booking process. If you would prefer to make a reservation over the phone, please call 800.605.9653.
The water park has showers, changing areas and lockers. The FAQ does not describe transfer space, accessible changing benches or adult changing tables.
There are lockers, showers, and changing areas available for your use in the water park.
Electronic lockers in the locker-room area can be rented for a fee in standard, large and jumbo sizes. The FAQ asks guests to keep anything larger than a standard suitcase in their room or vehicle.

There are electronic lockers available to rent for a nominal fee in our locker room area. They come in a choice of three sizes: Standard, large and jumbo. Any items or luggage larger than a standard size suitcase should be kept in your room or vehicle.
The lodge posts quiet hours from 11 p.m. to 7 a.m.; this is a policy, not a guarantee of a quiet room or environment.
11:00 p.m. -7:00 a.m. are the quiet hours for the lodge.
For dietary planning, the FAQ asks guests to contact the lodge and speak with a Food and Beverage Management team member about their needs and dining options.
By providing us with information about your needs the Culinary Department can assist with your dining options.
Please contact the lodge to speak with a Food and Beverage Management team member.
The accessibility page permits service animals except in or near pools. Confirm permitted waiting and circulation areas with the lodge.
Specifically, our facilities permit service animals (other than in or near pools)
